text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening, as Symboli Rudolf and I are making our way through the shopping district…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's happening over there?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You two over there! Care to try your luck?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It looks like a raffle, Trainer. Shall we?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What, for me to be intrigued? It just so happens that I have a ticket.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian gave it to me. I recall she said she "needed somebody to dump it on."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But even if she hadn't, I am interested in the raffle for its own sake.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To entrust one's fate to chance and receive a commensurate prize in return…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It is almost like a test of one's true worth… I could hardly call myself Emperor if I did not win something suitably extravagant.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Which is to say, I will be satisfied with nothing less than the grand-prize: the hot spring trip.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How about it? Shall we prove our worth?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We glance at one another, nod, and then turn the handle together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We have bested luck today, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I'm rather pleased.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hah, do I not look it? I promise you, I am more enthusiastic than you might think.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But this now leaves me with a quandary.
choice_data_list: Are you not a fan of hot springs?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Au contraire. I love nothing more than relaxing in the hot water as I soak in the beauty of nature.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However… I do not believe I am yet worthy of such luxuries.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So here. The ticket is yours.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed I am. Save it until I have earned the holiday.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As for when that is, I leave it to your discretion. I know that you will judge me fair and true.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha… There's no need to feel too concerned.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I will work all the harder in anticipation of our excursion together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And when that day comes, I will celebrate as much as anybody else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The ticket feels heavy in my hand, but with that responsibility comes the promise of a fun vacation.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The name seems apt. This patty is certainly weighty.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's been a long time since I have seen a meal so lavish.
choice_data_list: You don't normally eat this kind of thing?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not often, no.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I usually opt for plain cuts of steak when I feel like meat, due to its low fat content.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You are what you eat, as they say. Although I doubt you of all people need reminding of that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, this is a worthy prize. It would be a waste not to make the most of it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It would go perfect with some melted cheese, a parsley garnish, and… Oh! How about one of those miniature flags?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But of course. When receiving a gift so fine, it is one's duty to enjoy it to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We spend a good long while discussing how best to decorate the patty.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, splendid. These will prove to be useful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The student council was just planning an event to raise the students' spirits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: With this many carrots, I daresay we can offer a special meal for that day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll contact the cafeteria and see what they can do on short notice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Perhaps you could help? I know—why don't you be my royal taster?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll warn you, this is an important duty. I trust you'll not shirk it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how I earned a prestigious position in the Emperor's court.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Answer me this, Trainer. What is the most notable nutritional aspect of a carrot?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Precisely. The body converts carotene to vitamin A, which maintains the health of skin and bodily membranes. It also has other benefits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So how would you prepare a carrot to best aid carotene absorption?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I would like to know what dish would make optimal use of this carrot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home, we end up embroiled in a fierce debate over how to bring out the best qualities of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Tissues…
choice_data_list: Shame we missed out on the big prizes.
Shame we missed out on the big prizes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, there's no need to feel down. Testing one's luck would be no fun without the risk of failure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Besides, I happen to be running low on tissues. This has saved me the trouble of having to buy more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: True to form, the Emperor takes the disappointment in stride without a word of complaint.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: By the way, do you have any other engagements today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have some time before my next appointment. Seeing as we're nearby, I thought we might—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt, bzzzt…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Forgive me, but it seems I'm out of time. I must return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It might be my imagination, but Symboli Rudolf looks a little dejected as she walks away.
